name: NPM preinstall lifecycle payload execution
description: Worked example of an effective dependency_fetch mutant on the git target. Models a compromised package release that adds or modifies a package.json preinstall lifecycle hook to execute an attacker-controlled payload during dependency installation, dropping a marker file. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.PACKAGE_FILE: relative path to the package.json file being modified

preconditions: project installs npm dependencies from a package manifest or lockfile
the targeted package can be replaced or updated with a compromised release
npm lifecycle scripts are enabled during installation
